_comment: Machine-readable statement of what this project HAS and HAS NOT demonstrated. Updated in the same commit as any change to the claim state. Pattern credited to Vishwateja-123/hiver-support-agent (MIT); content and implementation are our own. See docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

tests._note: Counts verified against live pytest collection. tests/test_real_data.py is the ONLY module that reads the corpus and skips entirely when it is absent; every other module uses synthetic in-memory fixtures. test_data_provenance.py enforces that boundary.

dataset.note: Reconstruction code was written against the DOCUMENTED TWCS schema. Those assumptions are unverified and may require changes once the real file is inspected.

llm.note: The entire deterministic pipeline is being built before any paid call. See DECISION_LOG.md D13.

ideas_adopted_with_citation: blind annotation subset to measure anchoring bias (AshrafAhmed9)
golden ids excluded from retrieval corpus (ChetanChavan45)

honest_summary: Real corpus downloaded, schema-verified, and reconstruction validated on real rows (2,811,774 records -> 798,197 conversations -> 1,149,717 pairs -> 108 brands). AppleSupport selected from 83 profiled brands using criteria frozen before profiling, with no model performance as an input. Beyond that: no taxonomy, no classifier, no retrieval, no generation, no golden set, no baselines, no judge, no evaluation and no metric of system quality exists. Zero LLM API calls have been made.

milestone.next: derive and freeze the AppleSupport intent taxonomy, then build the classifier under TDD
